title: A question and an answer
summary: Two pipes make a conversation: one for each direction.
hints: Make two pipes before the fork: `up[2]` (parent to child) and `down[2]` (child to parent). Each process closes the two ends it does not use.
Ask one number at a time: the parent writes `n`, then reads the answer, before sending the next. The child loops until `read` on `up` returns 0.
